chain_words.nuance: mildly enjoyable to see, hear or experience
a general high level of visual or aesthetic appeal
beauty so striking that it draws immediate attention
beauty so overwhelming that it makes a viewer catch their breath

explanation: These words all describe appeal, moving from something mildly pleasant to beauty so overwhelming that it takes a viewer's breath away.

usage_notes.difference: 'Attractive' describes general appeal; 'stunning' describes beauty that is so striking it immediately captures attention.
